exposure: retained hardware after surgical treatment for a pelvic fracture
surgical fixation for a pelvic ring fracture
outcome: choice of delivery method (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: Women of childbearing age who underwent surgical fixation for a pelvic ring fracture between 1994 and 2021 and subsequently became pregnant.
finding: Women with retained hardware after pelvic ring fixation can have successful vaginal deliveries with rare complications, despite a high rate of primary caesarean sections (46%) which is likely influenced by physician bias.
mod_finding: Seven women had a total of 11 vaginal deliveries and 6 women had 6 caesarean sections, with maternal preference often influencing the decision for vaginal delivery and surgeon/obstetrician recommendations influencing caesarean sections.
